description: Source code for synthesizing magic methods for JIT-compiled dataclasses in PyTorch, including functions for creating __init__, __repr__, __hash__, and comparison methods, with integration to TorchScript.

methods.name: _get_fake_filename(cls, method_name)
methods.description: Generates a fake filename for a method, used during code synthesis.

methods.name: ParsedDef compose_fn(cls, name: str, body_lines: list[str], signature: str)
methods.description: Creates a ParsedDef object representing a synthesized function, parsing its source code into an AST.

methods.name: ParsedDef synthesize__init__(cls)
methods.description: Synthesizes the __init__ method for a dataclass, handling default factories and InitVars.

methods.name: ParsedDef synthesize__repr__(cls)
methods.description: Synthesizes the __repr__ method for a dataclass.

methods.name: ParsedDef synthesize__hash__(cls)
methods.description: Synthesizes the __hash__ method for a dataclass, currently raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: ParsedDef synthesize_equality(cls, name: str, converse: str)
methods.description: Synthesizes equality and inequality comparison methods (__eq__, __ne__).

methods.name: ParsedDef synthesize_inequality(cls, name: str, op: str, allow_eq: bool)
ParsedDef synthesize_comparison( cls, name: str, allow_eq: bool, raise_on_none: bool, inner: list[str] )
methods.description: Helper function to synthesize comparison methods based on dataclass fields.

ctags.name: compose_fn
ctags.pattern: /^def compose_fn(cls, name: str, body_lines: list[str], signature: str) -> ParsedDef:$/
ctags.signature: (cls, name: str, body_lines: list[str], signature: str)

ctags.name: synthesize_comparison
ctags.signature: ( cls, name: str, allow_eq: bool, raise_on_none: bool, inner: list[str] )

ctags.name: synthesize_equality
ctags.pattern: /^def synthesize_equality(cls, name: str, converse: str) -> ParsedDef:$/

ctags.name: synthesize_inequality
ctags.pattern: /^def synthesize_inequality(cls, name: str, op: str, allow_eq: bool) -> ParsedDef:$/
ctags.signature: (cls, name: str, op: str, allow_eq: bool)
